count.description: How many red ovals are in the image? Count an oval that is cut off by the edge of the image too. The blue squares are not ovals.

anyOf.description: No red oval, not even part of one.
Exactly one red oval, whole or cut off by the edge.
Two or more red ovals, whole or cut off by the edge.

box.description: the red oval in the image (only its visible part)

top.description: Top edge, as a fraction of the image's height from the top, from 0 to 1

bottom.description: Bottom edge, as a fraction of the image's height from the top, from 0 to 1

left.description: Left edge, as a fraction of the image's width from the left, from 0 to 1

right.description: Right edge, as a fraction of the image's width from the left, from 0 to 1
